description: Fails a record where SSH (22) or RDP (3389) is reachable from a public source (0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0) -- decisions.administrativePorts' default set. publicIngressPorts is the raw, unfiltered list of named ports a public-source rule opens; the collector applies no administrative-ports policy, so this is exactly where that judgment belongs. Not yet run through the Advanced Editor live -- push a record with publicIngressPorts: [22] and confirm it fails before relying on this in production.
